# `aitbc node test`

Test connectivity to a specific node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node test [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | yes | The Node id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node test --node-id <node_id>
```
